crater.$description: Crater — Borders, UI dividers, subtle background elements.

black-hole.$description: Black Hole — Darkest UI components, code blocks.

starlight.$description: Starlight — Primary text, active navigation, icons.

starlight-dim.$description: Starlight Dim — Subheadings, less prominent text.

comet.$description: Comet — Body copy, placeholder text, inactive-state UI.

asteroid.$description: Asteroid — Helper text, metadata, disabled states.

cosmic-lilac.$description: Cosmic Lilac — Primary CTA buttons — a calm but distinct call to action against the dark backdrop.

supernova.$description: Supernova — Focus rings, active state borders, UI highlights — a brighter violet for interactive feedback.

nebula-haze.$description: Nebula Haze — Decorative highlights, accent text.

warp-drive-glow.$description: Warp Drive Glow — Decorative background effect — adds a powerful, futuristic energy.

error.$description: Error — Error messages and destructive action states.

ibm-plex-serif.$description: Display headlines (54px) and large section titles (36-40px). The serif choice is a signature move, lending a classic, literary authority to a technical product. The tight negative letter-spacing is essential.

inter.$description: The workhorse font for all UI text, body copy, and subtitles. Its neutrality and readability provide a clean canvas that allows the serif headlines to stand out.

inter-tight.$description: Used for some medium-to-large headings, offering a slightly more condensed feel than Inter for specific layouts.

ui-monospace.$description: Code snippets and log outputs in product demonstrations, providing a familiar terminal aesthetic.
